run_bright_retrieval_evaluation: run retrieval evaluation on the BRIGHT benchmark for a given task and model
run_bright_bm25_evaluation: run BRIGHT benchmark evaluation using the BM25 retrieval model on a specified task
run_bright_long_context_retrieval: run retrieval evaluation on BRIGHT with long context documents enabled
run_bright_with_reasoning: run BRIGHT retrieval evaluation augmented with reasoning from a specified source
run_bright_document_expansion: run BRIGHT retrieval evaluation using expanded documents with gold or full expansion
